query:
SELECT p.id, p.empresa, p.ativo, p.observacoes, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cobranca_etapa_obs o WHERE o.planilha_id = p.id) as obs_count
FROM cobranca_planilha p 
WHERE p.empresa LIKE '%PANTANAL%' 
ORDER BY p.ativo DESC, p.id DESC;
